scholarships.name: Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: This scholarship programme offers you the opportunity to continue your academic education in Germany with a postgraduate course of study. The scholarships are funded by the German Federal Foreign Office.
scholarships.deadlineText: Application deadlines are updated annually in the second quarter. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year. You can find the current dates here:
scholarships.sourceQuote: You can apply if you have completed your first degree (e.g. Bachelor’s or Diplom) at the latest by the time the funding period begins. **Please note: For applicants from artistic disciplines and the field of architecture (including Urban Design)** , the DAAD offers the following scholarship programmes: [Architecture](https://www2.daad.de/deutschland/stipendium/datenbank/en/21148-stipendiendatenban…

eligibility.sourceQuote: You can apply if you have completed your first degree (e.g. Bachelor’s or Diplom) at the latest by the time the funding period begins.

eligibility.textValue: residency in Germany must not exceed 15 months at the application deadline
eligibility.sourceQuote: Your application **cannot** be considered, if you have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

eligibility.textValue: proof of proficiency in the language of instruction is required; accepted tests depend on the language of instruction
eligibility.sourceQuote: When you **apply to the DAAD for a scholarship** , you must provide proof of your **level of proficiency in the language of instruction** (German, English, or German **and** English) in your chosen study programme.
